_what: Three questions about the quarantines: did an edit-in-place keep the defect, how big is the blind spot where the question was edited too, and were any CORRECT rows removed.
_why_this_population: Arms 1 and 2 cover every quarantined row whose body is no longer live -- the population audit_quarantine_reach.py scores as cleanly gone. Arm 3 covers every quarantined row, because the question it asks is about the REMOVAL and therefore applies to rows that left correctly as well.
_what_this_cannot_show: Arm 2 is a similarity heuristic at 0.86 and will miss a question rewritten freely. Arm 3 inherits the classifier's 17 figure-testable classes: a quarantined row whose defect class is NOT figure-testable (stamp duty's flat-1% scope, the WCF 14+7 chain, P45/P9 terminology) produces no verdict and is counted in neither column -- it is unexamined, not cleared.

arm2_invisible_edit.quarantined_question: Thamani ya ardhi yangu inakadiriwa vipi kwa ajili ya stamp duty Tanzania?
arm2_invisible_edit.live_question_now: thamani ya ardhi yangu inakadiriwa vipi kwa ajili ya kuhesabu stamp duty tanzania?
arm2_invisible_edit.live_body_now: Stamp duty inatumika kwa uhamisho wa mali Tanzania. Viwango na taratibu halisi vinategemea aina ya mali na thamani yake inayotathminiwa na mthamini aliyesajiliwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Tathmini ya thamani ya ardhi kwa stamp duty inafanywa na wathamini waliosajiliwa (registered valuers) na inashughulikiwa na Ofisi ya Ardhi — inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu, Ofisi ya Ardhi, au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

arm2_invisible_edit.quarantined_question: PAYE ya mfanyakazi wangu mwenye mshahara wa TZS 800,000 kwa mwezi ni kiasi gani?
arm2_invisible_edit.live_question_now: paye ya mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa tzs 1,000,000 hasa kwa mwezi ni kiasi gani?
arm2_invisible_edit.live_body_now:
PAYE ya mshahara wa TZS 1,000,000 hasa kwa mwezi inakokotolewa kwa kanda za PAYE kama ifuatavyo:

Kanda 1 (0%): TZS 0 hadi 270,000 — kodi = TZS 0
Kanda 2 (8%): TZS 270,001 hadi 520,000 — TZS 250,000 x 8% = TZS 20,000
Kanda 3 (20%): TZS 520,001 hadi 760,000 — TZS 240,000 x 20% = TZS 48,000
Kanda 4 (25%): TZS 760,001 hadi 1,000,000 — TZS 240,000 x 25% = TZS 60,000

Jumla ya PAYE = TZS 128,000 kwa mwezi.

Mshahara wa TZS 1,000,001 na zaidi unaanza kuingia kanda ya 5 (30%). Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

arm2_invisible_edit.quarantined_question: Je, amri ya mishahara ya chini ya sekta binafsi ya mwaka 2022 bado ina nguvu tangu Januari 2026?
arm2_invisible_edit.live_question_now: je, amri ya mishahara ya chini ya sekta binafsi ya mwaka 2022 (gn 605a ya zamani) bado ina nguvu tangu januari 2026?
arm2_invisible_edit.live_body_now: Hapana. Amri ya mishahara ya 2022 ilifutwa rasmi kuanzia tarehe 1 Januari 2026. GN 605A (Agizo la Serikali Na.605A) la mwaka 2025 ndiyo amri mpya inayotumika, ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Mwajiri yeyote anayetumia viwango vya 2022 baada ya tarehe hiyo anachukuliwa kukiuka sheria. Thibitisha viwango vipya na PKF Eastern Africa au VELMA Law.

arm2_invisible_edit.quarantined_question: Je, biashara inayouza bidhaa za zero-rated inaweza kudai VAT ya pembejeo kwenye gharama zake?
arm2_invisible_edit.live_question_now: biashara inayouza bidhaa za exempt inaweza kudai vat ya pembejeo kwenye gharama zake?
arm2_invisible_edit.live_body_now: Hapana. Bidhaa za exempt (zilizosamehewa) hazitozwi VAT kabisa -- si usambazaji wa VAT. Kwa hivyo msambazaji wa bidhaa za exempt HAIWEZI kudai VAT ya pembejeo (input VAT) kwenye manunuzi yanayohusiana. Exempt na zero-rated si sawa -- tofauti hii inaathiri sana gharama za uendeshaji. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
